sourceText: Open small story: hash snapshot reuse / syndrome preflight for DONE and review gates. Follow-up story: parameterized fault injection for recovery-runner. Execute through current Lattice flow and report milestones.
normalizedOutcome: B-63ba adds an explicit offline recovery-runner parameterized fault profile capability while preserving the fixed B1-B15 default protocol and leaving lifecycle/evidence gate semantics unchanged.
acceptanceClaim: The recovery-runner selfcheck and focused CLI profile runs prove default fixed scenarios remain unchanged, explicit weighted/list profiles are deterministic and fail closed on invalid input, and docs mark the feature as exploratory offline harness work.
